insights: **Weekly Highlights —** Dormeo Canada grew total sales to $41,099 in Week 46, up 22.5% from $33,546 the prior week, on 115 units. Organic sales led the way at $12,119 (+226.3% WoW), and the Full Octaspring Topper nearly doubled to $7,398 (+97.4%) as units rose 100.0% to 20. The Queen Topper remained the anchor at $20,665 (+21.7%) on 54 units with a 5.8% conversion rate, and Tuesday, Nov 10 was the peak day at $7,623.

**Metrics to Watch —** PPC revenue eased to $28,979 (-2.9%) even as ad spend rose to $4,092 (prior $2,750), so this week's growth came mainly from organic demand rather than ads. The Twin Topper slipped to $1,105 (-20.6%) on 4 units with sessions down 10.6% to 412, while the Twin XL held at 8 units with $2,241 (-1.6%). We are focusing ad budget on the sizes that are converting to lift paid revenue back above last week's level.

**Ad Spend Efficiency —** Ads continued to deliver solid returns with a 14.1% ACOS on $4,092 of spend, a 0.53% ad CTR and 2.10% ad conversion. ROAS moved to 7.08x from 10.85x and TACoS to 10.0% from 8.20% because spend grew faster than ad-attributed sales, so we are trimming bids on lower-converting terms to bring ROAS back up.

**Actions This Week —** (1) Shift budget toward the Queen Topper (5.8% conversion) and the Full Topper, whose units doubled to 20, to build on that momentum heading into the holiday season. (2) Pause or lower bids on non-converting Twin and Twin XL search terms, targeting ROAS back toward 10.85x. (3) Test new Sponsored Brands ad creative to push ad CTR above 0.53%.
